text:
Sara Lim: Heads-up  we dumped ~45 onboarding transcripts + 12 Zendesk threads into the 'cs-voice-inbox' bucket. Need a quick triage: extract concrete asks, tag whether it's product/infra/enablement, and flag anything that smells like renewal risk. Who can take the first pass? :memo:

Tom Baker: I can take the morning shift. Quick Q: do we want atomic asks (one row per distinct ask) or keep whole-turn chunks?

Janelle Ortiz: Atomic asks please. PMs like discrete tickets. Suggest columns: customer, source, clip_id/ticket, short_ask, category, impact_score, renewal_signal, evidence_snippet, owner_reco

Kai Nguyen: For impact_score let's try a 0-10 composite: urgency(0-4) + frequency(0-3) + business_impact(0-3). Put a separate boolean for 'enablement_ok' if it's docs/training.

Sara Lim: Nice. Can we also mark 'repro steps' when the ask is a bug? That helps engineering triage. If transcript audio is bad, mark 'needs-listen'.

cs-bot: New file uploaded: cs-inbox-batch_1761112223.zip -> Drive https://drive.redwood.example/cs/inbox/batch_1761112223 :package:

Tom Baker: Starting manual pass on Acme, NorthBridge, and HelixBank. Will prioritize items with explicit "we will churn" language or renewal call notes. Expect a CSV in ~3h.

Janelle Ortiz: If you hit repeated asks across customers, tag them as 'pattern' and create a single canonical issue reference. PMs want deduped signals.

Tom Baker: Understood. Quick sample CSV header I'm using:
```
customer,source,ref_id,short_ask,category,urgency,frequency,business_impact,impact_score,enablement_ok,renewal_signal,evidence_snippet,notes
```

Kai Nguyen: Also add 'estimated_effort' (S/M/L) so PMs can triage faster. Small UX tweaks should be easy to slot into next sprint.

Tom Baker: Done. Sample rows after first pass:
```
Acme,transcript,acme_clip_11,"Need per-route billing breakdown","billing",3,2,2,7,false,true,""they asked for per-route cost per API"",
NorthBridge,zendesk,NB-892,"Enable private model pinning for compliance","infra",4,1,3,8,false,true,"requested by security lead during onboarding",
HelixBank,transcript,helix_04,"Confusing error when uploading custom vocab","bug",2,1,1,4,false,false,"stack trace audio excerpt: 'upload failed code 422'",
""
```

Janelle Ortiz: Great samples. For dedupe/pattern detection we should later run an NLU pass. For now manual tags + a 'pattern_id' column (empty if unique) will do.

Sara Lim: Plan: Tom finishes pass, Janelle does a quick dedupe + pattern tagging, Kai exports top-10 impact_score to create candidate roadmap tickets. I'll send a 1-pager to PMs and CSM leads before EOD. If an ask has renewal_signal=true, escalate during the PM sync and include the customer timeline.

Tom Baker: Flagging 3 noisy transcripts (low audio). Adding 'needs-listen' in notes. Also found 2 enablement asks (training videos + one-pager)  I'll mark enablement_ok=true for those.

cs-bot: Reminder: CS->Product triage meeting in 90 minutes. Agenda auto-added: "Inbox batch 1761112223: top patterns + renewal flags".

Kai Nguyen: After PMs review, let's automate: threshold impact_score >=7 OR renewal_signal=true -> auto-open a 'customer-voice' ticket with source evidence and customer contact. We'll include estimated_effort and pattern_id if present.

Janelle Ortiz: Agree. For enablement_ok items we'll auto-create a 'docs' card for the enablement team, not a product ticket. Cross-link if it's borderline.

Sara Lim: Thanks team  appreciate the fast turnaround. If anyone can't finish their pass, ping me and I'll reassign.

Tom Baker: Will ping when CSV ready. :white_check_mark:
